environment_intro: Each service gets an image built ahead, with its project's dependencies installed, so that a session starts on it in seconds.
environment_no_workspace: Connect a workspace first, at the step before: each of its services gets its image here.
environment_no_devcontainer: No .devcontainer: built on Cleared's session image.
environment_devcontainer_image: Built on the image its .devcontainer names.
environment_devcontainer_dockerfile: Built from the Dockerfile its .devcontainer names.
environment_foreign_image: {image} is not Cleared's session image: a session needs Node 24, Claude Code and Cleared's runner in it, or it cannot start.
environment_unreadable: Its base branch is not fetched yet.
environment_no_install: Declares no install command ([session] install_command in .cleared/agents.conf), so nothing is installed ahead.
environment_stale_line: Built before a change of its lock files, its install command or its .devcontainer.
environment_failed_todo: Fix the project's .devcontainer or its install command on its base branch, then build again.
environment_summary_ready: Every service's image is ready: sessions start on it.
environment_summary_building: Building. A first build installs the dependencies and can take a few minutes; you may leave this page.
environment_summary_failed_one: 1 build failed, of {count}. Fix what it says, then build again.
environment_summary_failed_many: {failed} builds failed, of {count}. Fix what each says, then build again.
environment_summary_todo_one: 1 image to build before the first session.
environment_summary_todo_many: {count} images to build before the first session.
environment_note: A merge that changes a lock file, the install command or the .devcontainer builds the image again. Each build reads the base branch only.
environment_error_invalid_workspace: The workspace file cannot be read. The checks step says why.
environment_error_other: The build could not start. Try again in a moment.
